title: Phantom Lens (PRISM): 196-D order-statistic representation and sealed cross-dataset evaluation for physics-grounded deepfake detection
description: Code and derived-feature deposit reproducing the physics-grounded deepfake-detection results (branch outstanding-results). Frozen model: 196-D order-statistic physics representation + RandomForest/ExtraTrees/LightGBM rank ensemble, trained on FaceForensics++ only. Sealed, identity-disjoint, pre-registered Celeb-DF-v2 test AUC 0.713 [0.687, 0.746]. Includes extraction/evaluation scripts, identity-disjoint splits, model-critical feature CSVs, per-video predictions, result JSONs, and pinned environment. Underlying video datasets are not redistributed; see DATASET_ACCESS.md.
notes: Seed 42. Sealed evaluation budget 1, spent once (see results/SEALED_final.json and the freeze/provenance docs on the outstanding-results branch). The Celeb-DF-v2 sealed half is a custom identity-disjoint split, not the official Celeb-DF test protocol.
